title: Lovely Lean Argentinian Steak Skewers
description: A funky and crunchy Argentinian dish featuring lean minced steak, perfect for a midnight craving, with a low-carb friendly twist.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the lean minced steak, onion, bell pepper, zucchini, garlic, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Mix everything together with your hands or a wooden spoon until just combined, being careful not to overmix.
Thread the mixture onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with olive oil on all sides.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the steak is cooked to an internal temperature of 160 degrees Fahrenheit.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
